question: Can a substantially smaller ExtraTrees selector retain the D431 rate signal on original and fresh campaigns?
number: Preregistered 96-model CV search selected 32 trees, depth 4, leaf 4, max_features 0.5. Fixed-model scores were original n=40 r=0.6306032037 ratio=1.2761523200 p=.0005; D432 n=20 r=0.6224397249 ratio=1.1022684705 p=.128; D433 n=40 r=0.6423610284 ratio=1.2654074491 p=.003. The model has 882 nodes and at most 128 comparisons plus 32 accumulators per candidate before feature extraction. Finite LOCAL_ONLY; safe gain 0.
